operations.command:
set -ex
u=$(nixosctl eval config.settings.users.admin.username | tr -d '"')
home=$(nixosctl eval config.settings.users.admin.homeDirectory | tr -d '"')
id "$u" >/dev/null
printf %s "$u" > /var/tmp/e2e-home-user
printf %s "$home" > /var/tmp/e2e-home-dir
test "$(stat -c %U:%G "$home")" = "$u:$u"
findmnt -rn -o SOURCE --target "$home" | grep -F '[/@home]'
btrfs subvolume list / | grep -F 'path @snapshots/@home/CLEAN'
test "$(btrfs property get -ts /.snapshots/@home/CLEAN ro)" = ro=true
if touch /.snapshots/@home/CLEAN/e2e-write-probe; then exit 1; fi
printf home-is-a-reset-volume

set -ex
u=$(cat /var/tmp/e2e-home-user)
home=$(cat /var/tmp/e2e-home-dir)
su -l "$u" -c 'set -e; mkdir -p ~/Downloads ~/.local/share/applications; chmod 750 ~/Downloads; echo early > ~/Downloads/early.txt; chmod 640 ~/Downloads/early.txt; echo first-command > ~/.bash_history; chmod 600 ~/.bash_history'
host=/etc/nixos/config/hosts/{{arch}}/VM-TEST/default.nix
keep="\"/etc/nixos\" \"$home/Downloads\" \"$home/.bash_history\" \"$home/.local/share/applications\""
sed -i "s|\"/etc/nixos\"|$keep|" "$host"
grep -F "\"$home/Downloads\" \"$home/.bash_history\" \"$home/.local/share/applications\"" "$host"
nixos-rebuild boot --flake /etc/nixos#VM-TEST-Standard-Boot
sync
printf home-paths-persisted

set -ex
u=$(cat /var/tmp/e2e-home-user)
home=$(cat /var/tmp/e2e-home-dir)
key=$(printf %s "$home" | sed 's|^/||; s|/|!|g')
btrfs subvolume list / | grep -F "path @persist/dirs/$key"'!Downloads'
btrfs subvolume list / | grep -F "path @persist/dirs/$key"'!.local!share!applications'
findmnt -rn -o SOURCE --target "$home/Downloads" | grep -F "@persist/dirs/$key"'!Downloads'
test "$(cat "$home/Downloads/early.txt")" = early
test "$(stat -c '%U:%G %a' "$home/Downloads")" = "$u:$u 750"
test "$(stat -c '%U:%G %a' "$home/Downloads/early.txt")" = "$u:$u 640"
test "$(cat "$home/.bash_history")" = first-command
test "$(stat -c '%U:%G %a' "$home/.bash_history")" = "$u:$u 600"
for owned in "$home" "$home/.local" "$home/.local/share" "$home/.local/share/applications"; do test "$(stat -c %U:%G "$owned")" = "$u:$u"; done
printf home-stores-made-from-live-data

set -ex
u=$(cat /var/tmp/e2e-home-user)
home=$(cat /var/tmp/e2e-home-dir)
su -l "$u" -c 'set -e; echo kept > ~/Downloads/kept.txt; echo second-command >> ~/.bash_history; echo app > ~/.local/share/applications/e2e.desktop; echo gone > ~/e2e-scratch.txt; mkdir -p ~/Documents ~/.local/share/e2e-scratch; echo gone > ~/Documents/e2e-note.txt; echo gone > ~/.local/share/e2e-scratch/file'
test "$(cat "$home/e2e-scratch.txt")" = gone
test "$(stat -c %U:%G "$home/e2e-scratch.txt")" = "$u:$u"
sync
printf home-written

set -ex
u=$(cat /var/tmp/e2e-home-user)
home=$(cat /var/tmp/e2e-home-dir)
test ! -e "$home/e2e-scratch.txt"
test ! -e "$home/Documents"
test ! -e "$home/.local/share/e2e-scratch"
printf home-scratch-gone

set -ex
u=$(cat /var/tmp/e2e-home-user)
home=$(cat /var/tmp/e2e-home-dir)
test "$(cat "$home/Downloads/kept.txt")" = kept
test "$(cat "$home/Downloads/early.txt")" = early
test "$(stat -c '%U:%G %a' "$home/Downloads")" = "$u:$u 750"
test "$(stat -c %U:%G "$home/Downloads/kept.txt")" = "$u:$u"
test "$(stat -c '%U:%G %a' "$home/Downloads/early.txt")" = "$u:$u 640"
test "$(tail -n 1 "$home/.bash_history")" = second-command
test "$(stat -c '%U:%G %a' "$home/.bash_history")" = "$u:$u 600"
test "$(cat "$home/.local/share/applications/e2e.desktop")" = app
for owned in "$home" "$home/.local" "$home/.local/share" "$home/.local/share/applications"; do test "$(stat -c %U:%G "$owned")" = "$u:$u"; done
su -l "$u" -c 'set -e; touch ~/.local/share/e2e-writable ~/Downloads/e2e-writable'
printf home-persisted-kept

set -ex
u=$(cat /var/tmp/e2e-home-user)
home=$(cat /var/tmp/e2e-home-dir)
name=$(basename "$home")
test "$(btrfs property get -ts /.snapshots/@home/CLEAN ro)" = ro=true
test ! -e "/.snapshots/@home/CLEAN/$name/e2e-scratch.txt"
test "$(cat "/.snapshots/@home/generation-1/$name/e2e-scratch.txt")" = gone
printf home-clean-snapshot-intact
